source_refs.title: Automatically back up with iCloud Backup
source_refs.section: Automatically back up with iCloud Backup
source_refs.verified_excerpt: You can back up your device manually
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Open the Settings app and tap your name. 2. Tap 'iCloud', then tap 'iCloud Backup'. 3. Make sure 'Back Up This [Device]' is turned on. Conditions: Connect the device to a power source. Connect the device to a Wi-Fi network. Make sure the device's screen is locked. If you see an alert that you don't have enough iCloud storage, follow the onscreen steps to buy more storage.

source_refs.title: Automatically back up your device
source_refs.verified_excerpt: You can back up content, data, and settings from your phone to your Google Account.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: 1. Open your device's Settings app. 2. Tap 'Google services', then 'All services'. Choose the data to back up: 'Photos & videos', 'Device data', or both. 3. Turn 'Backup' on. 'On' appears below each selected data type once the data is saved. Backup can't be used on a personal device set up with a work profile, a work-only device, or a company-owned device. Free backup storage is up to 15 GB. More storage is available through a Google One account. A Google One backup can take up to 24 hours.
